::: {.store-lede}
One row per WNBA game with who won the opening tip and who recorded each first of the game: first points, first field goal, each team's first scorer, and the first three-pointer, rebound, assist, steal, block and turnover, with shot types and game clock. Regular season, Commissioner's Cup final and playoffs are in one file, told apart by season_type; preseason and the All-Star game are left out.
:::

## Columns

One row per game. 65 columns. A row is identified by `game_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>season</td><td>string</td><td>Season the game belongs to, written like 2026.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>Part of the season: regular_season, cup_final (the Commissioner&#x27;s Cup championship game) or playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>League game id, ten digits starting with 10; keep it as text so the leading digits survive.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in U.S. Eastern time, as the league lists it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the home team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_source</td><td>string</td><td>How the opening tip winner was determined: jump_ball (the play-by-play records who gained possession from the opening jump), violation (a jump ball violation, so the team that took first possession is credited) or first_possession (no usable opening jump in the play-by-play, so the team with the first shot, turnover or free throw is credited).</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_home_jumper_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the home team&#x27;s jumper on the opening tip; blank when the play-by-play does not identify the jumpers.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_home_jumper_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the home team&#x27;s jumper on the opening tip.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_away_jumper_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the away team&#x27;s jumper on the opening tip; blank when the play-by-play does not identify the jumpers.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_away_jumper_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the away team&#x27;s jumper on the opening tip.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_winner_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that won the opening tip, meaning the team whose player gained possession from it; after a re-jump, the jump that led to the first possession counts.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_winner_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the winning team&#x27;s jumper; blank when the jumpers are not identified.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_winner_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the winning team&#x27;s jumper.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_score_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the first team to score in the game, by field goal or free throw.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_points_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who scored the game&#x27;s first points; a made free throw counts, so when a free throw goes in before any field goal the free throw shooter is the first scorer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_points_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who scored the game&#x27;s first points.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_points_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that scored the game&#x27;s first points.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_points_shot_type</td><td>string</td><td>How the first points were scored: dunk, layup, other_fg (any other two-point field goal), three_point or free_throw. A three-pointer is always three_point; dunk and layup are read from the play description; an and-one is recorded as the made field goal, since the free throw comes after it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_points_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first points were scored, in seconds of game time from the opening tip (a play at 9:43 of the first period is 17); plays in the same second are ordered as the league&#x27;s play-by-play lists them.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_fg_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who made the game&#x27;s first field goal; free throws do not count, so this differs from the first points scorer when a free throw came first.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_fg_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who made the game&#x27;s first field goal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_fg_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that made the game&#x27;s first field goal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_fg_shot_type</td><td>string</td><td>Type of the game&#x27;s first made field goal: dunk, layup, other_fg (any other two-point field goal) or three_point.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_fg_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first field goal was made, in seconds of game time from the opening tip (a play at 9:43 of the first period is 17).</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_three_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who made the game&#x27;s first three-pointer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_three_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who made the game&#x27;s first three-pointer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_three_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that made the game&#x27;s first three-pointer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_three_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first three-pointer was made, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_rebound_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first rebound.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_rebound_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first rebound.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_rebound_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that got the game&#x27;s first rebound. In seasons before 2026 a rebound or turnover charged to a team counts as the first one; the player columns are then blank and the team column still names the team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_rebound_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first rebound happened, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_assist_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first assist.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_assist_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first assist.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_assist_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team credited with the game&#x27;s first assist.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_assist_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first assisted basket was made, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_steal_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first steal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_steal_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first steal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_steal_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team credited with the game&#x27;s first steal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_steal_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first steal happened, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_block_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first blocked shot.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_block_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player credited with the game&#x27;s first blocked shot.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_block_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team credited with the game&#x27;s first blocked shot.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_block_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first block happened, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_turnover_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player charged with the game&#x27;s first turnover.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_turnover_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player charged with the game&#x27;s first turnover.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_turnover_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team that committed the game&#x27;s first turnover. In seasons before 2026 a rebound or turnover charged to a team counts as the first one; the player columns are then blank and the team column still names the team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_turnover_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the first turnover happened, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_points_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who scored the home team&#x27;s first points (field goal or free throw).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_points_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who scored the home team&#x27;s first points (field goal or free throw).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_points_shot_type</td><td>string</td><td>How the home team&#x27;s first points were scored: dunk, layup, other_fg (any other two-point field goal), three_point or free_throw.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_points_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the home team first scored, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_fg_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who made the home team&#x27;s first field goal (free throws do not count).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_fg_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who made the home team&#x27;s first field goal (free throws do not count).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_fg_shot_type</td><td>string</td><td>Type of the home team&#x27;s first made field goal: dunk, layup, other_fg (any other two-point field goal) or three_point.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_first_fg_seconds</td><td>float</td><td>When the home team made its first field goal, in seconds of game time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_first_points_player_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the player who scored the away team&#x27;s first points (field goal or free throw).</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_first_points_player_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the player who scored the away team&#x27;s first points (field goal or free throw).</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_first_points_shot_type</td><td>string</td><td>How the away team&#x27;s first points were scored: dunk, layup, other_fg (any other two-point field goal), three_point or free_throw.</td></tr>

```

## Source and method

Built by Slam Dunk Bets from the league's play-by-play with the same first-event pipeline that grades our first basket picks. A game the pipeline could not read has its row with the event columns blank.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More WNBA data

[Player Game Logs](wnba-player-logs.qmd) · [Team Game Logs](wnba-team-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](wnba-play-by-play.qmd) · [Games and Results](wnba-schedule.qmd) · [All WNBA data](wnba.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the WNBA files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every WNBA file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season, Commissioner's Cup final and playoff game, from the official box scores and play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
